correctness.rationale: Source (2.1) contains no spatial derivatives or spatial convolution and gives an independent age-structured initial-value problem at each x. Pointwise uniqueness preserves the uninfected zero solution outside a compact initially infected set. Equation (3.7) is exactly F(cλ), where f=-L′≥0 has total mass at most one. For every c>0 a sufficiently large λ makes F(cλ)<1, proving the source-defined infimum c*=0. Its F is strictly decreasing for every u>0, so c∂F/∂u<0 and the positive-speed stationary system has no solution. The exact ℓ=1, q=S0=1, η=4, γ=0 example gives R0=4 and F(u)=4/(1+u)^2. The attached code was executed from its actual package path and confirmed all rational identities. The theorem does not equate contour motion from everywhere-positive initial data with propagation of new support.

The separate earlier same-source analysis addresses a fixed-latent simulation attenuation factor, not spatial support or transform selection. value.rationale: The central 2024 mathematical and policy application claims kilometer-per-week spatial spreading speeds and sensitivity to quarantine, yet its equations have no mechanism for infection to cross spatial sites. The repaired exact prediction for the source-defined speed is zero for all parameter values, and its double-root selection problem has no positive solution. This is a structural counterexample to the applicability of the principal wave-speed computation and to interpretation of the published contour plots, not an unused numerical correction. It isolates the modeling ingredient—spatial coupling—needed for genuine propagation.
